exposure: Artificial ventilation (discussed as a risk factor)
Mode of birth (C-section mentioned in discussion)
cohort: A single preterm newborn weighing 690g at birth, born at 26 gestational weeks.
finding: A retinal hemorrhage was found in the preterm newborn during ROP screening, which persisted for nearly 20 weeks before complete resorption, without signs of retinopathy of prematurity.
mod_finding: The discussion mentions that retinal hemorrhages are less common in children born preterm and with C-section, while extremely low birth weight and artificial ventilation are associated with increased risk.
